speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Terminal Extensor Rupture).

The history of trauma followed by the inability to actively flex the distal interphalangeal joint (DIP), pain at that joint, and the finger extending in a resting position is classic for an extensor tendon avulsion or rupture. While the X-ray I requested will confirm if there is an associated avulsion fracture, the clinical presentation is highly specific for this injury.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
